Quinte West launches new physician recruitment program; two new doctors signed

Zach McGibbon
Aug 12, 2026 | 3:28 PM

Quinte West Mayor Jim Harrison with Physician Recruiter and Engagement Specialist Jessica Smylie on the launch of Quinte West's physician recruitment program. August 12, 2026. (Photo: Tim Durkin/Quinte News)



Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:40
Instaread

The City of Quinte West announced it has launched its own physician recruitment program at a press conference on Wednesday.

In addition to the launch announcement, the city announced it signed two new family physicians that will be starting practices in Quinte West.

The two doctors announced are Dr. Bailey Brant, who received his Doctor of Medicine in 2026 at the University of Toronto, and Dr. Siddarth Varatharajan, who is a candidate for his Doctor of Medicine at the University of Queensland, Australia in 2032.

Jessica Smylie is the municipal Physician Recruiter and Engagement Specialist.

Smylie says the partnership captures the city’s vision of taking a holistic and tailored approach to the community’s health care landscape.

“Our focus is straightforward: to facilitate growth for additional healthcare infrastructure, advocate for healthcare services to remain here in the city of Quinte West, and to provide a competitive, well-rounded incentive package for primary care partners.”

In the announcement, the city touted four recruitment incentives which are broken down as follows:

  • Primary Care Physician Recruitment Incentive – $175,000 for a five-year full-time service agreement within the City of Quinte West,
  • Primary Care Nurse Practitioner Incentive – $15,000 for a five-year full-time service agreement within the City of Quinte West
  • Emergency Room Physician Incentive – two independent $75,000 incentives for a five-year full-time return to service agreement within the City of Quinte West at the Trenton Memorial Emergency Room Department,
  • Hospital Physician Incentive – two independent $75,000 incentives for a five-year full-time service agreement within the Trenton Memorial Hospital Medical Inpatient Unit.

The full announcement can be found at the City of Quinte West’s YouTube page.
